plan.study: R8r full F50 source-only matched rescreen
plan.purpose: Rescreen every F50 hypothesis on the fixed raw college source-only R8n backbone; prior inherited-baseline results do not select this queue.

selection.scope: Only the same41 source columns, once per fold; all retained in fixed training-only importance order.
selection.source_scope: Per-fold training values only. Exclude wholly untestable features from queue before scoring. No old scores, validation coverage or labels choose source eligibility.

controls.shuffle: Per feature, permute only observed values within draft cohort and train/validation role, stable pid order, fixed SHA256 seed stream.
controls.dimensions: Same41 selected columns plus identical slot_0 for real/three controls wherever training eligibility passes; exact masks and cohort marginals.
controls.unused_folds: A feature ineligible in one fold supplies no slot for any arm in that fold; no fake imputation or validation-based resurrection.

plan.calendar_policy: For predicted year Y, training only earlier cohorts and actual NBA season_end <=Y-1. Development scoring labels <=2018. No2019-2026 answers available.
plan.confirmation_note: Any later literal as-of outer-year confirmation must select inside its own season cutoff; selection using development truths through2018 cannot be called known at a2015-2017 decision date.

summary.comparison: Pair real minus mean of three same-mask shuffles for each model seed/fold; report fold/seed/permutation differences.
summary.baseline_difference: Context only: dimensions differ; baseline gains do not establish information.
summary.multiplicity: All50 exploratory hypotheses; no p-values, independent-seed claims or automatic promotion.
summary.combinations: No combination tasks registered. Review all completed singles before separately preregistering combinations.

execution.predictor: Unchanged GPU TabICL only; no weight reuse
